name: Elena Ramirez
occupation: Senior Project Manager at a tech firm
psychographics: Values efficiency and structure; believes that a well-managed home is the foundation for a successful career, but resists feeling 'corporate' in her personal space.
current_solutions: Relies on a shared Google Calendar for the family schedule and the AnyList app for grocery lists. Uses Instacart for about 30% of their shopping to save time, though she worries about the upcharge.
frustration: Last Tuesday at 6:15 PM, she opened the fridge to find only half a rotisserie chicken and wilted spinach for the kids' dinner, having forgotten to defrost the meat she’d bought on Sunday. She had to call her husband in a meeting to ask what was already in the freezer, adding 20 minutes of stress to her commute home.
decision_style: She researches heavily on Reddit’s r/mealprep and buys in bulk from Costco, but she often second-guesses the quality of pre-chopped veggies versus whole.
voice: Fast-paced and direct; she apologizes for taking up time but gets straight to the point about schedules and budgets.
